# Illinois Association of School Boards

> IASB is Illinois' premier advocacy and professional development organization for school boards, providing governance training, legislative updates, and member resources.

The Illinois Association of School Boards (IASB) serves as the unified voice for school boards across Illinois, offering comprehensive training programs, advocacy initiatives, and networking opportunities. IASB supports effective school governance through educational resources, policy guidance, and connection to a statewide community of educational leaders.

## Key Topics

- School Board Governance
- Advocacy & Legislative Updates
- Professional Development
- Illinois Education Policy
- Delegate Assembly
- Division Meetings
- Joint Annual Conference
- Educational Resources
- School Code
- Governance Training
- Advocacy Ambassadors
- Public Education
- Board Operations
- Finance & Budget
- Executive Leadership

## Organization & Leadership

- [About Us](https://www.iasb.com/about-us): IASB organization overview, history, membership, and governance structure
- [Vision And Mission](https://www.iasb.com/about-us/vision-and-mission): IASB vision, mission, values, and advocacy priorities
- [Strategic Priorities](https://www.iasb.com/about-us/vision-and-mission/strategic-priorities): IASB strategic priorities for fiscal year 2026 and advocacy initiatives
- [IASB Constitution](https://www.iasb.com/about-us/leadership/constitution): IASB constitution, governance structure, and organizational bylaws
- [IASB Staff](https://www.iasb.com/about-us/staff): IASB staff directory with executive leadership and contact information

## Training & Professional Development

- [Online Learning](https://www.iasb.com/online-learning): Online courses and webinars for board member training and mandatory compliance
- [Foundational Principles of Effective Governance](https://www.iasb.com/training-and-events/training/training-resources/foundational-principles-of-effective-governance): Training resource on foundational governance principles for school boards
- [Pamphlets and Tools](https://www.iasb.com/about-us/publications/pamphlets-and-tools): IASB educational resources on governance, finance, and board operations

## Events & Community

- [Event Listing](https://www.iasb.com/calendar): IASB event calendar with division meetings, advocacy days, and professional development
- [Home - IASB Community](https://community.iasb.com): IASB Community platform for member access and resource sharing

## Advocacy & Policy

- [Position Statements](https://www.iasb.com/about-us/leadership/position-statements): IASB position statements and policy resolutions on education issues

## Publications & Resources

- [Publications](https://www.iasb.com/about-us/publications): IASB publications including journal, podcast, and governance resources
- [Illinois School Board Journal](https://www.iasb.com/about-us/publications/journal): Bimonthly IASB journal with member content and education news

## Specialized Services

- [Executive Searches](https://www.iasb.com/about-us/executive-searches): IASB superintendent hiring and executive search services
